hooks.command: f=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$f" | grep -q 'chaincode/'; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"TIP: Chaincode changed - run /sync-backend-with-chaincode when ready (syncs backend + redeploys CC)."}'; elif printf '%s' "$f" | grep -qE 'backend/|src/(controllers|routes|services)/'; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"TIP: Backend changed - run /sync-backend-only to push to Ubuntu."}'; fi
